in_sanskrit.name: वीजयत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विजय: विजयितुम् साक्षिणोत् स्वस्थानम् प्राप्नोति । वीजयत् स विजयी । (vijayat: vijayituM svasthanam prApnoti | vījayat sa vijayī)

in_hindi.name: वीजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: विजय: विजयितुम् साक्षिणोत् स्वस्थानम् प्राप्नोति । (vijay: vijayituM svasthanam prApnoti)

in_tamil.name: வீஜயம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஜயம்: விஜயித்தல் விஷயம் வீஜப்படுதல். (vijayam: vijayiththal vishyam vējappaṭutal)

in_telugu.name: వీజేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: విజయేశ్: విజయీయోళ్ళుదోటిపోయిన శశ్యపోయిన దేశముదే. (vijayēś: vijayīyōlлуdupotinu deśamudē)

in_marathi.name: Jeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit' which means 'victory'. The name is given to a child born during a victory or after a victory is achieved.

in_bengali.name: Jeet
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jeet একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit' which means 'victory'. The name is given to a child born during a victory or after a victory is achieved.
